import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int DEBUG = 0;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int inv(int n) {
        int e = MOD-2,r = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if (e % 2 == 1) r = (int)((long)r*n % MOD);
            e >>= 1;
            n = (int)((long)n*n % MOD);
        }
        return r;
    }

    static class Debug {
        public Debug print(Object... args) {
            for (Object arg : args) System.out.print(arg + " ");
            System.out.println();
            return this;
        }
    }

    static Debug debug = new Debug();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int[][] P = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            }
        }

        int k, h = (n+1)/2;
        int h2 = n-h;
        int inv100 = inv(100);
        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> masks2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            int c = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) c++;
            }
            if (c == h) masks.add(i);
            if (c == h2) masks2.add(i);
        }

        long[] prob = new long[1 << n];
        long[] prob2 = new long[1 << n];
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (n*h)); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n*h; j++) {
                int x = j/n, y = j % n;
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) p = (p * P[x][y] * inv100) % MOD;
                else p = (p * (100-P[x][y]) * inv100) % MOD;
            }
            int poss = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < masks.size(); j++) {
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if ((masks.get(j) & (1 << k)) != 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k*n + v.get(k);
                        if ((i & (1 << a)) == 0) break;
                    }
                    if (k == v.size()) {
                        poss |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob[poss] = (prob[poss] + p) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (n*h2)); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < n*h2; j++) {
                int x = j/n + h, y = j % n;
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) p = (p * P[x][y] * inv100) % MOD;
                else p = (p * (100-P[x][y]) * inv100) % MOD;
            }
            int poss = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < masks.size(); j++) {
                List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if ((masks.get(j) & (1 << k)) == 0) v.add(k);
                }
                do {
                    for (int k = 0; k < v.size(); k++) {
                        int a = k*n + v.get(k);
                        if ((i & (1 << a)) == 0) break;
                    }
                    if (k == v.size()) {
                        poss |= (1 << j);
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(v));
            }
            prob2[poss] = (prob2[poss] + p) % MOD;
        }
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < masks.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << masks.size()); j++) {
                if ((j & (1 << i)) != 0) prob2[j] = (prob2[j] + prob2[j^(1 << i)]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << masks.size()); i++) {
            ans = (ans + (long)prob[i]*prob2[((1 << masks.size())-1)^i]) % MOD;
        }
        pw.println((MOD+1-ans) % MOD);

        pw.close();
    }

    static void nextPermutation(List<Integer> list) {
        int n = list.size();
        int i = n-2;
        while (i >= 0 && list.get(i) >= list.get(i+1)) i--;
        if (i == -1) {
            Collections.reverse(list);
            return;
        }
        int j = n-1;
        while (list.get(j) <= list.get(i)) j--;
        Collections.swap(list, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(list.subList(i+1, n));
    }
}
